name: statistical-analysis
description: Python-based statistical analysis job demonstrating data science workloads

payload.script: import random; import json; random.seed(42); data = [random.gauss(100, 15) for _ in range(10000)]; json.dump(data, open('/tmp/sample_data.json', 'w')); print(f'Generated {len(data)} samples')

import json; import statistics; data = json.load(open('/tmp/sample_data.json')); stats = {'mean': statistics.mean(data), 'median': statistics.median(data), 'stdev': statistics.stdev(data), 'variance': statistics.variance(data), 'min': min(data), 'max': max(data), 'n': len(data)}; json.dump(stats, open('/tmp/descriptive_stats.json', 'w')); print(stats)

import json; import statistics; data = json.load(open('/tmp/sample_data.json')); data_sorted = sorted(data); n = len(data); percentiles = {f'p{p}': data_sorted[int(n * p / 100)] for p in [10, 25, 50, 75, 90, 95, 99]}; json.dump(percentiles, open('/tmp/percentiles.json', 'w')); print(percentiles)

import json; data = json.load(open('/tmp/sample_data.json')); min_val, max_val = min(data), max(data); num_bins = 20; bin_width = (max_val - min_val) / num_bins; histogram = [0] * num_bins; [histogram.__setitem__(min(int((x - min_val) / bin_width), num_bins - 1), histogram[min(int((x - min_val) / bin_width), num_bins - 1)] + 1) for x in data]; bins = [{'start': min_val + i * bin_width, 'end': min_val + (i + 1) * bin_width, 'count': histogram[i]} for i in range(num_bins)]; json.dump(bins, open('/tmp/histogram.json', 'w')); print(f'Histogram with {num_bins} bins created')

import json; stats = json.load(open('/tmp/descriptive_stats.json')); percentiles = json.load(open('/tmp/percentiles.json')); histogram = json.load(open('/tmp/histogram.json')); report = {'descriptive_statistics': stats, 'percentiles': percentiles, 'histogram_bins': len(histogram), 'analysis_complete': True}; json.dump(report, open('/tmp/final_report.json', 'w'), indent=2); print(json.dumps(report, indent=2))
